title: Agent Technology Radar — Source Registry
description: Schema for config/default-sources.json (the source registry). IMPORTANT: this file is unrelated to config/config-schema.json, which describes the end-user config at ~/.follow-builders/config.json. Source entries are NOT validated at runtime — the loader in scripts/generate-feed.js enforces a subset (literal `id` present, `id` globally unique). This schema is the written specification.
$comment: Deliberately not wired to a validator in Phase 1A. Adding a schema-validation dependency would be unrelated scope; the loader's fail-fast covers the two failure modes that matter.

schemaVersion.description: Structure version of the registry itself.

sourceId.description: Stable source identity, format `<type-prefix>:<slug>` (prefixes: x, podcast, blog). Hand-assigned and stored literally — NEVER derived at runtime from `name` or a URL, so that renaming a display name or changing a URL cannot silently change identity. Immutable once published: Phase 2's signal `source_id` refers back to this value.

name.description: Display name. Not an identity — changing it must not change `id`.

active.description: true = included in fetching; false = kept in the registry but skipped by the loader.

rssUrl.description: RSS feed used to discover episodes. Read by fetchPodcastContent.

url.description: YouTube channel or playlist URL, used to resolve the exact video URL for an episode by title matching. Read by fetchPodcastContent.

indexUrl.description: Read by fetchBlogContent. NOTE: the parser is dispatched by substring match on this value (generate-feed.js:912-916: `anthropic.com` / `claude.com`), and the article extractor likewise by the article URL (generate-feed.js:961-965). Adding a blog on a new domain therefore still requires a code change.

type.description: CONFIRMED UNUSED — zero code references (verified by grep). Retrieval strategy is decided implicitly by the URL substring dispatch described on `indexUrl`. Cleanup deferred to Phase 1B.

articleBaseUrl.description: CONFIRMED UNUSED — zero code references (verified by grep). Article URLs are hardcoded instead: `https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/${slug}` and `https://claude.com/blog/${slug}` (generate-feed.js:686, 709, 734). Cleanup deferred to Phase 1B.

fetchMethod.description: CONFIRMED UNUSED — zero code references (verified by grep). Cleanup deferred to Phase 1B.

id.description: Derived once, by hand, from the lowercased handle. The X numeric user id is deliberately NOT stored — fetchXContent resolves it at runtime via batched username lookup.

handle.description: X handle WITHOUT a leading @. Read by fetchXContent.
